text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: (The wind, the footsteps, the breaths—a clash of fiery passion hot as blazing flames!)

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
(This is the greatest stage with all of you!
I've been waiting for this day for so, so long—!)

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Fufu, ahahaha! Ahahahahaha!

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text:
Taaaaaaaaaaahhh—!!
Haaaaaaaaaaahhh—!!
Daaaaaaaaaaahhh—!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
At Nakayama in the year's twilight, seizing victory after a fierce battle,
it's Mr. C.B.!

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
......!
...Man, she really is incredible, amazing, awesome!

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
"So completely free, enjoying the race to the fullest...!
Enjoying the race more than anyone else!"

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text: ...I see. Because CB is like that, I fell in love with that dream the moment I saw her.

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for letting me dream.
...Thank you, C.B....!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Aaargh, damn it!
I really thought today was gonna be the day."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Still... it was really fun...
Running alongside them...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"...No, no, no! I can't do this!
CB's getting to me!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"The signal fire for our rebellion starts right here!
Uwooooh!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: It was a total defeat.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I believed that only by defeating the free-spirited you could I claim the throne of "Emperor."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
My dream, shattered.
...I was still not good enough.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
There's still so much left to build.
You made me realize that, C.B.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
......Heh.
...Still, to smile in a situation like that...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Utterly flawless and natural...
I really am no match for you.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: —Phew...!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
*Sigh*... Amazing. No matter how much I run,
it won't stop. It's still burned into my eyes.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Rudolf and Ace's fierce roars,
the rising dust, the thunderous cheers—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Everything on the turf was sparkling.
It was fun. Yeah... it was so much fun...!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'm gonna run a bit more!
It'd be such a waste to just go to sleep now!

—Mr. C.B., who
brilliantly conquered the Arima Kinen.

In the "mythology" recounted later on,
everyone said in unison:
That there was an Umamusume named Mr. C.B., who was freer than anyone else.
